text:
Maria: FYI vendor sent updated arrival windows for our H100 allocation — looks like three staggered shipments over two weeks. some batches flagged 'possible DOA' (vendor note). need quick decision: consolidate at EU pool or split to region DCs? @Devon @Aj
Devon: how many units in each shipment? any serial ranges flagged?
Maria: Shipment A: 24 units (ETA +3 days), Shipment B: 16 units (ETA +7 days), Shipment C: 40 units (ETA +13 days). Vendor flagged ~2–4 units per batch as higher DOA risk based on preflight test. no serial ranges provided yet.
Aj: If DOA risk is nontrivial, we should route first small batch to AMS for faster depot turnaround (repairs + RMA). consolidation adds customs delay. Cost delta?
Maria: vendor offered to cover ground-insurance for consolidated ocean, but air expedite for DOA replacements would be extra. quick estimate: reroute first 24 by air -> +$24k. consolidating everything into EU pool saves ~48 hrs avg customs -> less operator churn but delays initial capacity.
Leo: Also note capacity pressure in us-west fleet next week. If we hold too long we risk customer queue. suggest split: A -> EU-AMS, B->US-North, C->EU pool. keeps some capacity local.
nexa_ops: Hi team — confirming manifest: A (AWB: EK1234567890, 24u), B (AWB: EK1234567891, 16u), C (AWB: EK1234567892, 40u). We flagged #A with 3 high-risk units (pre-fail). We can pre-issue RMA labels for up to 5 units per AWB; standard RMA SLA 14 days. If you want air replacement for pre-fails, we can expedite at vendor cost + handling.
Aj: can you pre-generate return labels for all shipments? we prefer preprinted labels to speed depot intake. also need HS codes and insurance values for customs.
nexa_ops: Sending manifest with HS/values now — attaching as snippet below:
```
AWB: EK1234567890 | HS: 847150 | Value: 45000 EUR | Pre-fail flagged: 3
AWB: EK1234567891 | HS: 847150 | Value: 30000 EUR | Pre-fail flagged: 1
AWB: EK1234567892 | HS: 847150 | Value: 75000 EUR | Pre-fail flagged: 2
```
logistics-bot: Created RMA ticket #RMA-2026-1142 for AWB EK1234567890 (3 pre-fail units). Assigned -> Devon.
Devon: got it. I'll open depot slots for AMS on arrival day +1 and book repair lanes.
Maria: decision time: proceed with Leo's split routing. vendor to preprint return labels and hold air-replacement pending our confirmation (we'll likely approve for shipment A only). Aj — approve the +$24k air spend?
Aj: approve for shipment A only given high pre-fail count. please confirm vendor pays standard RMA ground for consolidated returns; we cover expedited air only for A.
Maria: confirmed. Maria -> nex a_ops: Please: 1) Preprint RMA labels for all AWBs. 2) Change routing: A->EU-AMS by air (vendor invoice +$24k), B->US-North ground, C->EU pool ocean. 3) Hold air-replacement until we confirm measured DOAs at AMS.
nexa_ops: Acknowledged. We'll update AWB and send revised invoice for the expedite line item. ETA change applied. Revised manifest and preprinted labels will arrive in the next 4h.
Leo: I'll reserve AMS depot slots and provision cross-docks. Devon — I'll need the depot contact and expected arrival window to confirm staff.
Devon: pinged ops team separately with AWB and arrival slot. added 2 repair lanes next-day.
Maria: perfect. I'll track cost delta and add to procurement ledger. tagging @finance for the extra expedite spend. :spiral_calendar: :money_with_wings:
Aj: also log this as a tactical exception in procurement tracker and flag vendor performance for allocation reliability review.
Maria: will do. Thanks team — follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
